0.sub: Remote · Seller Center – Marketplace Platform (Vue.js 3 / React / TypeScript)
bullets: Spearheaded React and TypeScript front-end development for Seller Center, Walmart's marketplace platform supporting billions in annual GMV, and built its embeddable seller-support chat widget in Vue.js 3 + TypeScript (Composition API, Pinia); set architecture standards, code review protocols, and system design documentation for a cross-functional squad of 6+ engineers.

Integrated web clients with 6+ internal marketplace microservices over REST and Socket.IO/WebSockets, and built Seller Center's interactive analytics with D3.js and SVG: zoomable sales and order-volume timelines, geographic heat maps of orders by region, and drill-down charts, with a GenAI seller-support assistant streaming Claude API / LangChain responses through Node.js middleware.

Shipped through GitHub Actions CI/CD with automated Jest, React Testing Library, and Supertest gates; containerized backend services with Docker on AWS ECS/Fargate with RDS PostgreSQL; monitored platform health in Dynatrace.

1.sub: Remote · Enterprise Field Operations Platform (Vue.js / React)
bullets: Led a cross-functional team implementing Vue.js and React (TypeScript) front ends for AEP's field operations platform, integrating 10+ microservice REST APIs and complex data-entry workflows used by thousands of utility technicians nationwide.
Implemented secure authentication and authorization flows (JWT, role-based access) and offline-tolerant data sync; integrated Azure AI Services to summarize and classify field notes.

Automated build and release pipelines in Azure DevOps with Docker-based agents and automated test gates in two-week Scrum sprints; instrumented Dynatrace APM (session replay, error tracking), cutting P1 mean time to resolution by 50%.

Led engineering for the studio; shipped 0-to-1 Vue.js, React and Next.js products with Node.js and Firebase backends for clients in three countries, including a contactless QR digital menu and ordering platform built in Vue.js and deployed at 50+ restaurants during COVID-19.

Architected a gas delivery tracking platform supporting 300+ daily deliveries with live driver location and push notifications on a Node.js/Express backend on AWS in Docker; built a wine e-commerce storefront with JWT-secured third-party API integration and an analytics dashboard that drove 120% year-over-year sales growth.
